SELECT id, tool_name AS toolName, description, parameters, method, url_template AS urlTemplate, body_template AS bodyTemplate, headers, credential_id AS credentialId, extract_path AS extractPath, max_response_bytes AS maxResponseBytes, timeout_millis AS timeoutMillis, speed, enabled, status, version_no AS versionNo, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM http_tool_config WHERE tool_name = #{toolName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO http_tool_config (tool_name, description, parameters, method, url_template, body_template, headers, credential_id, extract_path, max_response_bytes, timeout_millis, speed, enabled, status, version_no) VALUES (#{toolName}, #{description}, #{parameters}, #{method}, #{urlTemplate}, #{bodyTemplate}, #{headers}, #{credentialId}, #{extractPath}, #{maxResponseBytes}, #{timeoutMillis}, COALESCE(#{speed}, 'FAST'), #{enabled}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'published'), COALESCE(#{versionNo}, 1))
mapper.update: UPDATE http_tool_config SET description = #{description}, parameters = #{parameters}, method = #{method}, url_template = #{urlTemplate}, body_template = #{bodyTemplate}, headers = #{headers}, credential_id = #{credentialId}, extract_path = #{extractPath}, max_response_bytes = #{maxResponseBytes}, timeout_millis = #{timeoutMillis}, speed = COALESCE(#{speed}, 'FAST'), enabled = #{enabled}, status = #{status}, version_no = #{versionNo} WHERE tool_name = #{toolName}
